projects.name: token-warden
projects.tagline: A Claude Code plugin that makes coding agents measurably cheaper over time
projects.description: Treats agent memory as an engineering problem: every rule that wants space in an agent's context must prove — on a frozen benchmark — that it saves more tokens than it costs, or it gets evicted. A four-stage loop (collect → distill → benchmark → select) keeps only rules with a measured, positive return, and the collector runs in a fail-open hook that never blocks a session.

projects.name: PR Scout
projects.tagline: CLI that finds and LLM-scores beginner-friendly GitHub issues
projects.description: Fetches open good-first-issue tickets from any repository and scores each 0–10 with an LLM on clarity, scope, spam signals, and actionability — filtering out stale projects via star count, commit recency, and merged-PR health checks. Top candidates land in an interactive picker that opens issues straight in the browser.

projects.name: Trinomen
projects.tagline: Three-agent LLM pipeline in the terminal — route, generate, review
projects.description: A router classifies the request, a worker generates with intent-scaled token budgets, and an adversarial reviewer on a separate provider audits the output against strict React/TypeScript standards. A --loop mode typechecks in a sandbox and iterates until it passes. Benchmarked one-shot vs. compiler-retry vs. full pipeline, then redesigned it gate-first after the ablation showed reviewer-everywhere cost ~5× the tokens for worse results.
